title: BootProbeRequest
description: The input of servtuner boot-probe: a vLLM that booted with these knobs and no load. bench reads vllm:cache_config_info from its /metrics through the target's own hop and prints a tuningBootResult (boot-results.schema.json) with num_gpu_blocks and c_kv = num_gpu_blocks x block_size / tokens_per_request.

knobs.description: The knobs the target booted with; copied into the result.

tokens_per_request.description: Mean prompt plus generated tokens per request of the session's workload: the planned means, since a boot probe has no measured requests.
